name: Yanagi Touwa
source:
Touwa is the second-in-charge of the school's Theatre Club. Almost nothing like his loud and attention-seeking childhood friend, Sei'ichiro, Touwa is antisocial, blunt, stoic and somewhat of a sadist. His father is a well-respected director working for the Stella Theatre, where Jun Hikari performs. 

[spoiler]After high school, Touwa goes on to become a theatre director at the Stella Theatre.[/spoiler]
